title: keyboard-first-compact-mode-ia-sketches
content:
Purpose
- Capture a small, pragmatic exploration of a keyboard-first compact navigation mode that can live alongside the existing left rail. Goal: reduce cognitive load for power users, preserve quick access to key flows (deploy, models, usage), and make deep linking / ephemeral routes work without inflating sidebar complexity.

Context / Why now
- Console is getting more routes (rollouts, cost-analysis, model variants). Left rail density is increasing and mobile/smaller-window experiences are brittle. We want a secondary compact surface optimized for keyboard users and short journeys (open resource, jump to recent, quick create).
- This doc is intentionally lightweight: sketches + a prioritized backlog for a small beta to validate interaction patterns.

Design constraints
- Must be keyboard-first: open with cmd/ctrl+K or '\' (tilde) and allow 1-2 keypress flows to reach target.
- Preserve discoverability for new users via subtle badges and onboarding for first use.
- Not a replacement for full left rail but a complementary fast-path for repeat tasks.
- Accessibility: ARIA roles, focus management, predictable tab order.
- Support deep links (URL) for every compact action so third-party integrations can use it.

Sketches / micro-interactions (text wireframes)
1) Activation
- Keystroke: Cmd/Ctrl+K (global). Also a small top-right hot-pill that opens the compact mode with mouse.
- Visual: translucent overlay dims content; compact panel centered on left 420px width on desktop, full-width on narrow screens.

2) Anatomy of compact panel
- Row 1: search input (placeholder: 'Jump to commands, routes, or objects (type / for create)').
- Row 2: recent actions (6 max) with small icons and quick-actions (open in new tab, pin).
- Row 3: fuzzy-matched actionable items: routes (models, deployments, logs), commands (create deployment, open rollout), snippets (token metrics query).
- Row 4: footer with hint: 'Enter = open, Shift+Enter = open in new tab, ? = shortcuts'.

3) Keyboard flow examples
- Quick open a deployment: Cmd+K -> type "deploy my-service" -> Enter (navigates to /deployments/my-service)
- Jump to logs: Cmd+K -> "logs my-dep" -> ArrowDown -> Enter (open logs with preserved scope filter)
- Create resource: Cmd+K -> / -> type "model" -> Enter opens lightweight create modal (route-preserving)

Routing implications (engineering notes)
- Compact actions map to existing routes; use history.pushState so back button behavior is preserved.
- For ephemeral commands that open modals, we should append a query param like ?compact=1 to support direct linking and telemetry.
- When navigation originates from compact mode, console should record a small event (source: compact_panel) for feature analytics.

Backlog (MVP -> Beta)
- MVP (2 sprints)
  - CONSOLE-842: Compact panel shell with global keyboard hook and styling (acceptance: open/close works, focus lands in input).
  - CONSOLE-843: Fuzzy matcher for routes & commands (support name, alias, and id).
  - CONSOLE-844: Deep-link mapping + history integration (append ?compact=1 for modal opens).
  - CONSOLE-845: Basic recent actions + telemetry (store last 10 in localStorage, send analytics).

- Beta (post-MVP)
  - CONSOLE-846: Pinning & persistent favorites (server-backed).
  - CONSOLE-847: Shortcuts cheat-sheet and first-run onboarding prompt.
  - CONSOLE-848: Accessibility sweep + keyboard navigation e2e tests.
  - CONSOLE-849: Mobile styling + full-width adaptation.

Open questions / trade-offs
- Should compact mode include RBAC filtering server-side? Open to either local-filtered list or API-backed allowed-actions. Risk: latency if every keystroke hits server. Proposal: client-side fuzzy over a cached action index refreshed on sign-in / route change; fallback to server for rare queries.
- How opinionated should command names be? Keep aliases to align with UX and CLI where possible (e.g., "deploy" vs "create deployment").
- Metrics to validate success: adoption rate (users who trigger compact >= 3 times/wk), average time-to-target (goal < 4s), and displacement of left-rail clicks for power users (reduce left-rail opens by 15% for power cohort).

Acceptance criteria (MVP)
- Compact opens with Cmd/Ctrl+K and hot-pill click.
- Typing fuzzy matches routes and commands within 300ms on 95th percentile machines.
- Hitting Enter navigates to the correct route and sets history so back button works.
- Analytics events emitted with source=compact_panel for open/select actions.
- Focus order and ARIA roles pass basic axe checks (no critical failures).

Implementation notes for engineers
- Frontend module: console/components/CompactPanel.tsx. Keep minimal DOM on mount; lazy-load matcher weights.
- Matcher: use fuse.js tuned for short tokens and prioritize recent/pinned results. Cache index in sessionStorage with expiry.
- Telemetry: events/compact.open, events/compact.select with context {user_id, route, latency_ms, source}.
- Styling: follow theme tokens; overlay uses backdrop-filter: blur(6px) on supported platforms.

Design handoff
- Figma file above contains frames: "Compact base", "Compact with modal create", "Mobile compact". Designer notes in Figma: prioritize 16px tap targets on mobile, show subtle affordances for pinned items.

Notes from 2026-02-25 working session (decision highlights)
- Agreed to keep compact mode additive; no changes to current left rail for MVP.
- Want to experiment with "/" prefix for create flows to align with GitHub quick open.
- Need an experimentation plan: ramp to 10% of active users with telemetry gated by feature flag.

Next steps
- Action: Aisha to prototype keyboard flows in Figma by 2026-03-08.
- Action: Marcus to spike a matcher using fuse.js and return perf numbers by 2026-03-12.
- Action: Lena to write a short betatest plan and create CONSOLE-850 for funnel analysis.

Appendix: short command lexicon (working, not exhaustive)
- deploy <service> -> /deployments/:id
- models <name> -> /models/:id
- rollout <name> -> /rollouts/:id
- tokens -> /billing/tokens
